description: Geotechnical Database for Utah (GeoDU) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Steven Bartlett, University of Utah (utah.edu). This project includes three geotechnical borehole databases compiled in Utah (i.e., Utah, Weber and Salt Lake counties), which has been coined the Geotechnical Database of Utah (GeoDU). The database can be used to quantify geotechnical engineering properties for subsequent liquefaction evaluations of surficial geologic units comprised of similar depositional environment and age. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2ST19. Keywords: Geotechnical Database, Soil Properties, SPT, Liquefaction, Geology, Geohazards. Published 2018-09-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
